eligibility_questions.label: Has AUB assessed you as an overseas fee payer?
Do you hold the AUB offer for this exact course and intake?
Did you submit the scholarship application by the published deadline for your intake?
Has AUB granted you this international scholarship?
Have you accepted the scholarship under AUB’s instructions?
Does the award letter make this amount applicable to the fee period being compared?
Have you confirmed that you are not combining it with another AUB financial award or bursary?
What exact scholarship amount has AUB granted for this fee period? Use the award letter; do not enter the advertised maximum unless that is your award.

rules.scope_note: Exact reviewed campus course IDs and compared year only. Deduct the actual granted amount, bounded by the published maximum, once saved personal facts are confirmed. The AUB adapter is required; the generic calculator cannot interpret confirmed_amount.
